verdict.rationale: A probe returned HTTP 200 for an llms.txt at rocm.docs.amd.com, the documentation site that covers ROCm on Radeon 9000-series GPUs including the RX 9070 XT. The file notes that each ROCm project has its own additional llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this card's software stack. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt content depth and coverage specific to the RX 9070 XT, any other agent-oriented doc formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using it.
